blocks.text: The module documentation distinguishes freely callable reads from confirmation-gated mutations and explains the shared daemon/MCP pending store. Imports and exports establish the two integrations.
blocks.title: Tool policy and event boundary

blocks.text: Display payload helpers truncate strings, omit full write content while retaining byte counts, normalize MCP names, and emit lifecycle events without making logging load-bearing.
blocks.title: Safe activity payloads

blocks.title: Read-only daemon calls

blocks.text: PendingAction records the source, parameters, workspace, and creation time. A flat process-local dictionary is pruned by a fifteen-minute expiration check.
blocks.title: Pending action registry

blocks.text: Daemon mutations require known tools and required fields. MCP proposals parse and classify the agent-tool name, rejecting read-only tools before storing a pending action.
blocks.title: Proposal creation

blocks.text: Confirmation removes the action before execution, then dispatches to either the daemon or MCP implementation and records outcomes. Denial removes the proposal and emits the corresponding lifecycle event without executing anything.
blocks.title: Confirm or deny

gotchas: Pending actions are process-local and disappear on backend restart.
Read tools bypass propose/confirm; mutating tools do not contact their target until confirmation.
Event emission is display-oriented and intentionally excludes full file content.
